name: MPRLS ported pressure sensor (0-25 psi)
description: Honeywell MicroPressure MPR series absolute pressure sensor with a 2.5 mm hose port, 0-25 psi (0-1724 hPa), 24-bit I2C output (transfer function A: 10 % to 90 % of 2^24 counts). The chip runs at 3.3 V; the breakout has a 3.3 V regulator and SDA/SCL level shifters. Sold as: Adafruit MPRLS Ported Pressure Sensor Breakout - 0 to 25 PSI (product 3965), 7-pin header VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, EOC, RST, I2C address 0x18.
eli5: Measures air pressure in a tube or bottle you connect to its little nozzle, like a tyre gauge your board can read.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply 3-5 V into the on-board 3.3 V regulator (MIC5225); the I2C pull-ups go to this voltage, so use 3.3 V with an ESP32/Pico

pins.name: 3Vo
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator; not a supply input, leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock; level shifted to 3.3 V on the board, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data; level shifted to 3.3 V on the board, 10 kΩ pull-up to VIN

pins.name: EOC
pins.description: End-of-conversion output (3.3 V logic, high when a reading is ready); optional

pins.name: RST
pins.description: Reset input, active low (pulled up to 3.3 V on the board, diode-isolated); optional

supplierQuery: Adafruit MPRLS ported pressure sensor breakout 0-25 PSI 3965
buildNotes: Write 0xAA 0x00 0x00, then wait until the busy flag (status bit 5) clears, at least 5 ms, or EOC goes high; read 4 bytes: status, then 24-bit pressure counts.
Status bit 6 must be 1 (powered); bit 2 = memory integrity error, bit 0 = math saturation: discard the reading if either is set.
Pressure (psi) = (counts - 1677722) x 25 / (15099494 - 1677722). Multiply by 68.947572932 for hPa.
The SDA/SCL pull-ups go to VIN: power the board from 3.3 V when it shares the bus with an ESP32 or Pico.
It is an absolute sensor: open to air it reads about 14.7 psi (1013 hPa) at sea level. Push 2.5 mm ID tubing over the port.
Overpressure limit 60 psi, burst 120 psi; readings above 25 psi are out of range (math saturation). Opaque tubing is recommended: the die is light sensitive.

driver.code:
# Honeywell MPRLS (MPR series, I2C) pressure sensor, MicroPython driver.
# Written from the Honeywell MPR Series datasheet (32332628):
#  - I2C address 0x18; output measurement command 0xAA 0x00 0x00.
#  - Wait for the busy flag (status bit 5) to clear, or >= 5 ms, or EOC high.
#  - Read 4 bytes: status, then 24-bit pressure counts (MSB first).
#  - Status: bit 6 = powered (must be 1), bit 5 = busy, bit 2 = memory integrity
#    error, bit 0 = math saturation.
#  - Transfer function A (10 % to 90 % of 2^24 counts):
#    P = (counts - 1677722) * (Pmax - Pmin) / (15099494 - 1677722) + Pmin
# The Adafruit breakout uses the 0-25 psi absolute part (MPRLS0025PA00001A).
import time

OUTPUT_MIN = 1677722   # 0x19999A, 10 % of 2^24
OUTPUT_MAX = 15099494  # 0xE66666, 90 % of 2^24
PSI_TO_HPA = 68.947572932

_POWERED = 0x40
_BUSY = 0x20
_MEM_ERR = 0x04
_MATH_SAT = 0x01


class MPRLS:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x18, psi_min=0.0, psi_max=25.0, eoc=None):
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        self.psi_min = psi_min
        self.psi_max = psi_max
        self.eoc = eoc  # optional machine.Pin (input) wired to EOC
        time.sleep_ms(3)  # power up to data ready: 2.5 ms max

    def status(self):
        return self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 1)[0]

    def read_raw(self):
        """Run one measurement and return the 24-bit pressure counts."""
        self.i2c.writeto(self.addr, b'\xaa\x00\x00')
        t0 = time.ticks_ms()
        time.sleep_ms(5)  # datasheet option 2: at least 5 ms per conversion
        while True:
            if self.eoc is not None:
                done = self.eoc.value()
            else:
                done = not (self.status() & _BUSY)
            if done:
                break
            if time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t0) > 50:
                raise OSError('MPRLS timeout: sensor stayed busy')
            time.sleep_ms(1)
        d = self.i2c.readfrom(self.addr, 4)
        st = d[0]
        if not st & _POWERED:
            raise OSError('MPRLS not powered (status 0x%02x)' % st)
        if st & _MEM_ERR:
            raise OSError('MPRLS memory integrity error')
        if st & _MATH_SAT:
            raise OSError('MPRLS math saturation (pressure out of range)')
        return (d[1] << 16) | (d[2] << 8) | d[3]

    def pressure_psi(self):
        raw = self.read_raw()
        return (raw - OUTPUT_MIN) * (self.psi_max - self.psi_min) / (OUTPUT_MAX - OUTPUT_MIN) + self.psi_min

    def pressure_hpa(self):
        return self.pressure_psi() * PSI_TO_HPA

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from mprls import MPRLS

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = MPRLS(i2c)
while True:
    psi = sensor.pressure_psi()
    print('P=%.2fpsi %.1fhPa' % (psi, psi * 68.947572932))
    time.sleep(1)
